lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Check the exits before you go shopping in there.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Do I get a loyalty card?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Come back alive twice. I will find you a stamp.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ...Why is there a chair by the door?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Mine. Get going.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Hold still. There is blood on your sleeve.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Not mine.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: You all say that. Arm up.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You always this bossy?

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Only the ones still breathing.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: If this thing makes a noise, do not kick it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What if it catches fire?

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Then kick me. I am cheaper to replace.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: I can hear you.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: ...No one here appreciates maintenance.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: The one by the window keeps making jokes when I change his bandage.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Any good?

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Awful. Today he stopped halfway through one.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I will get the dressings.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: And clean fabric. Not the shirt off your back. Keep that on.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I found the exits. Am I officially useful now?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Tang Kui needs dressings. Go ask her.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That is a very moving award speech.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: You want a medal or a bandage?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Bandage.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Do not sell all the fabric. Tang Kui will skin us both.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Us? What did you do?

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Borrowed a bit of her lamp cable.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Did you ask?

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: I was hoping you would change the subject.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: He finished the joke. It was worse than I thought.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Want to tell me?

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: No. Survive your next trip and suffer in person.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Now there is a reason to live.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Try it. I have your dinner.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Someone said hello through the static last night.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Maybe a recording?

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: I swore at the radio. She swore back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Definitely alive, then.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Help me get both relays working. I want to hear her again.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Su Mi wants you to fix the line. Not run into the sealed buildings.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You told her that?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Three times.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Four. I heard you the first time.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Then stop packing that bag.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Who was on the radio?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: I do not know. The archive recorder might tell us what happened.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You want a machine brought back. Su Mi wants a person.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: I want you back. Start with that.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Leave the radio there.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You have been listening all night.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I will check the recorder. You eat something.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Put it beside the radio.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I heard the recording. I lost the device.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: We can go back for it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: They called her an asset.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: I heard you. Put the bag down. Your hands are shaking.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Did the recorder say where she was?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: No. I could not bring it back.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: ...Okay. Next trip. Do not run back out now.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You first. Put your bag down.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: I fixed their line.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: We heard someone asking for help.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: And I powered their equipment. I could rip the whole thing out.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: My people are on that line too.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: ...I know. L-02B off. L-02A stays. I marked them. Twice.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You heard the woman in the recording?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And the guard still would not open the door.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Do not tell me he was following orders.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: I was not going to.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Su Mi asked me what to write beside the shelter switch.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: I gave her the names of everyone in there.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That is a lot of names.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Good. Let her complain about the handwriting.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: They all wanted to thank you on the radio.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I only heard someone asking about soup.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: That was me. They were blocking the stove.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So, where is the soup?

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Sit down. Yours has been waiting.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: L-02B is dark. The shelter is still talking.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You can sleep now.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: After this call.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That is what you said three calls ago.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: ...You sound like Tang Kui.

cut_shen.title: Not the one you are wearing

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: They need spare armor. Keep yours on.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I have not even offered it yet.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: You were pulling at the straps.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You watch people too closely.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Armor and sixty rounds. All there.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: South dormitory window. I will stay on the radio until you are back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Still sitting by the door?

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: The chair is comfortable.

finish_tang.title: A bowl with your name on it

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Somebody wrote your name on a bowl.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So no one steals my food?

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: So the new cook knows to save you some.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ...You could have said that normally.

lines.speaker: tang_kui
lines.text: Eat. It is getting cold.

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: Someone is singing on the shelter channel.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The woman we heard before?

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: I do not know.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Want me to turn it off?

lines.speaker: su_mi
lines.text: No. He is terrible. Come listen.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The road is open. They have supplies. You can move the chair.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Where to?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Anywhere. You do not have to keep watch.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: You going out again?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ...Probably.

lines.speaker: shen_yanshuang
lines.text: Then leave it.
